title: Release Amount and Net Payment of a Held Income Annuities Installment
content:
The installment settled is the one held in suspense on the Ashgrove Income Annuities contract for the latest held payment date; its held amount is the total held for that payment date.

**Amount released.** The whole held installment is released, and the part forfeited back to the contract is the held installment less the amount released. The joint installment of a payment date is the installment most recently issued on the contract.

**Tax.** Its taxable part is the amount released less a tax-free part equal to that amount multiplied by the exclusion ratio on the contract, rounded to the cent, but never more than the purchase amount less the tax-free amount already recovered and never less than zero. The tax-free amount already recovered is the purchase amount less the unreturned purchase amount, multiplied by the exclusion ratio, rounded to the cent. Federal tax is withheld from the taxable part at the rate on the contract's withholding election, rounded to the cent. No state tax is withheld.

**Overpayment.** Nothing is applied to any overpayment.

**Amount sent.** The amount sent is the amount released less the federal tax, the state tax and any amount applied to an overpayment. Each amount is rounded to the cent on its own.

### Worked figure (hypothetical)

| Input | Value |
|---|---|
| Held for the latest held payment date, 1 June | $2,000.00 |
| Exclusion ratio | 30% |
| Purchase amount | $400,000.00 |
| Unreturned purchase amount | $310,000.00 |
| Contract's withholding election | 10% |

Released $2,000.00; forfeited $0.00. Already recovered: $90,000.00 multiplied by 30%, that is $27,000.00, leaving $373,000.00 of room. Tax-free part $600.00; taxable part $1,400.00; federal tax $140.00; state tax none; nothing applied. Amount sent: **$1,860.00**.
